_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the EP-DJ3000 wire contract. Edit this file, then run `python3 tools/gen_protocol.py` to regenerate the C++/Swift/JS/markdown artifacts. `python3 tools/gen_protocol.py --check` fails if any generated file has drifted. Never hand-edit generated files.

device.name: EP-DJ3000
device.usbIdNote: DEV PLACEHOLDER (pid.codes test PID). Request a real PID from https://pid.codes (open hardware) before sharing units.

cables.name: Deck
cables.desc: This unit's own controls, clock and transport. Always present.

cables.name: TRS MIDI
cables.desc: Pass-through to/from the 3.5 mm TRS MIDI jack (external gear, e.g. EP-133 K.O. II).

cables.name: Linked deck
cables.desc: The peer deck, bridged over the radio link when the peer has no USB host of its own. Silent otherwise.

midi.channelsNote: Zero-based. Deck A = channel 1, Deck B = channel 2 (as shown in DJ software).
midi.relativeNote: Relative controls are offset-64: value = 64 + delta, delta in [-63, +63]. 64 means no motion. Positive jog delta = platter turned clockwise (when jogInvert = 0).

controls.desc: Platter motion, relative offset-64. 1024 ticks = one full revolution.
Slide pot when faderRole = CROSSFADER. 14-bit: MSB CC 23, LSB CC 55. Always sent MSB first, then LSB; an unchanged half may be skipped.
Slide pot when faderRole = CHANNEL_VOLUME. 14-bit: MSB CC 7, LSB CC 39.
Slide pot when faderRole = PITCH (tempo fader). 14-bit: MSB CC 25, LSB CC 57.
Orange knob. 14-bit: MSB CC 24, LSB CC 56.
Tempo, value = BPM x 10 (14-bit, 20.0..300.0 valid). Host->device sets tempo; device->host reports tempo changes in SYNC_MASTER mode.
Tempo change, relative offset-64, one step = 0.1 BPM.
Absolute transport state: 0 = stop, 1 = play, 2 = pause. Unambiguous alternative to toggle notes.
CUE button. Out: vel 127 down / 0 up. In: vel > 0 lights the button (deck cue state).
REV button. Out: vel 127 down / 0 up.
Platter touched (vel 127) / released (vel 0). Enter/leave scratch mode.
Play/pause toggle. Out: pulse (127 then 0) on a platter tap when tapPlay = 1. In: vel > 0 = deck is playing (LED feedback).
Tap tempo. In: host taps tempo. Out: sent when a tap is detected in SYNC_MASTER mode.

realtime.note: Clock/transport/MTC are only EMITTED when mode = SYNC_MASTER, on the ports in clockOutMask. They are always accepted (cable 0) to track tempo and mirror transport state.

sysex._comment: Frame: F0 7D 45 44 <ver> <deck> <cmd> <packed payload...> <checksum> F7. 7D = non-commercial manufacturer ID, 45 44 = 'E','D'. Payload bytes are packed 8->7 (see PROTOCOL.md). checksum = (-(sum of bytes ver..last payload septet)) & 0x7F. Replies use cmd | 0x40; ACK = 0x7E, NAK = 0x7F (payload [cmd, errorCode]).

commands.name: GET_CONFIG
commands.resp: CONFIG (0x42): [key u8, value i32le] (one per key)

commands.name: SET_CONFIG
commands.desc: Apply a config value live (not persisted until SAVE_CONFIG).

commands.name: SAVE_CONFIG
commands.desc: Persist the live config to flash.

commands.name: LOAD_DEFAULTS
commands.desc: Reset live config to defaults (call SAVE_CONFIG to persist).

commands.name: STREAM
commands.desc: Start/stop raw telemetry (0 = off, max 100 Hz). Auto-stops after 5 s without a refresh.

commands.name: CAL_BEGIN
commands.desc: Begin recording extremes of a control (kind = CalKind).

commands.name: CAL_END
commands.desc: Finish; apply=1 writes the measured range into the live config.

commands.name: SET_DECK
commands.desc: Set deck A/B, persist, and re-enumerate USB (reboot).

commands.name: LINK_STATUS
commands.resp: LINK (0x4B): [count u8] + count x struct Peer
commands.desc: Peers visible on the radio link.

commands.name: TEST_TONE
commands.desc: Play a sine on the DAC output (audio path test). Auto-stops after 10 s.

commands.name: IDENTIFY
commands.desc: Flash the status LED so you can tell which physical unit this is.

config._comment: All values travel as int32 on the wire. `type` is informational for UIs/storage. Add new keys at the END; ids are permanent.

keys.name: deckId
keys.desc: Which deck this unit is (A/B). Sets default MIDI channel and USB name.

keys.name: midiChannel
keys.desc: Zero-based MIDI channel 0..15, or 16 = auto (follow deckId).

keys.name: mode
keys.desc: DJ controller, standalone clock master, or clock follower.

keys.name: platterSource
keys.desc: How platter rotation is sensed: AS5600 magnetic encoder, segmented capacitive touch ring (conductive PLA), or touch/hold only (no rotation).

keys.name: jogInvert
keys.desc: Flip jog direction.

keys.name: touchSectors
keys.desc: Number of capacitive sectors in the platter ring.

keys.name: touchOnPermille
keys.desc: Finger-down threshold, per-mille rise over baseline.

keys.name: touchOffPermille
keys.desc: Finger-up threshold (hysteresis), per-mille rise over baseline.

keys.name: tapPlay
keys.desc: A quick touch with no movement toggles play/pause.

keys.name: tapMaxMs
keys.desc: Longest touch that still counts as a tap.

keys.name: tapMoveTicks
keys.desc: Platter movement (ticks of 1/1024 rev) allowed during a tap.

keys.name: faderRole
keys.desc: What the slide pot controls (changes the CC it sends).

keys.name: faderRawMin
keys.desc: 12-bit ADC reading at one end of travel.

keys.name: faderRawMax
keys.desc: 12-bit ADC reading at the other end of travel.

keys.name: faderInvert
keys.desc: Flip fader direction.

keys.name: faderDeadLoPermille
keys.desc: Dead zone at the low end (per-mille of travel).

keys.name: faderDeadHiPermille
keys.desc: Dead zone at the high end (per-mille of travel).

keys.name: faderCurve
keys.desc: Response curve; SHARP_CUT gives a scratch-style fast cut.

keys.name: knobRole
keys.desc: GENERIC sends CC 24; BPM turns the knob into a tempo control.

keys.name: knobRawMin
keys.desc: 12-bit ADC reading at one end of the knob.

keys.name: knobRawMax
keys.desc: 12-bit ADC reading at the other end of the knob.

keys.name: knobInvert
keys.desc: Flip knob direction.

keys.name: clockOutMask
keys.desc: Ports that receive clock/transport/MTC in SYNC_MASTER mode.

keys.name: bpmX10
keys.desc: Current tempo x10 (120.0 BPM = 1200).

keys.name: mtcEnable
keys.desc: Emit MIDI Time Code in SYNC_MASTER mode.

keys.name: mtcFps
keys.desc: MTC frame rate type (see mtcFpsTypes).

keys.name: dacMode
keys.desc: USB audio output: AUTO detects a DAC, ON forces it, OFF is MIDI-only. Takes effect after reboot (USB descriptors change).

keys.name: linkEnable
keys.desc: Enable the unit-to-unit radio link.

keys.name: linkBridge
keys.desc: Forward the peer deck's MIDI over this unit's USB (cable 2). AUTO bridges only when the peer has no USB host.

keys.name: trsMidiEnable
keys.desc: Enable the 3.5 mm TRS MIDI jack (cable 1).

keys.name: ledBrightness
keys.desc: Status LED brightness.

keys.name: buttonDebounceMs
keys.desc: Button debounce time.

structs._comment: Little-endian, packed, no padding. Carried inside SysEx payloads (after 8->7 packing).
